$comment: The code spans of a table cell as the core reads them (what a fact over the cell's column compares). The cell is as a runner receives it: the page's text with \| undone. Every language's cell helper is tested against this table, and so is the core.

cases.name: a backslash in a span is kept
a less-than sign alone is text
a link holds no link
a link's destination holds none
a link's text holds spans
a link's title holds none
a longer run does not close
a pipe the core unescaped
a run closes only on as many
a shorter run inside a longer one
a span holds what looks like HTML
a span of spaces is empty
an HTML attribute holds no span
an HTML comment holds no span
an autolink holds no span
an escaped backslash escapes none
an escaped backtick opens nothing
an image may hold a link
an unclosed run is text
brackets that make no link are text
double backticks hold a backtick
emphasis around a span is not kept
no code span
no-break spaces and tabs go too
one span
several spans, in order
spaces around the content go
spaces let a span hold backticks
spans among text
the core's white space: no-break space and BOM go, U+0085 stays
